segmentler.metin: Amtrak Cascades train 501 derailed onto Interstate 5 near DuPont.
It took only entering a 30 mph curve at 78 mph.
So how could entering a 30 mph curve at 78 mph do this?
The answer is overspeed on a curve without active positive train control and with an inadequately trained engineer — and it is why service on the route waited for positive train control.
